rollback_trigger: Any regression in nested export paths (e.g., reports/partner-billing/2026-04/export.csv) or increase in 403 errors on legitimate export requests.
impact_scope: export_api/storage.py: _normalize_requested_path now iteratively decodes percent-encoded input until stable; resolve_export_path now checks for absolute paths before stripping, uses split-based component detection for traversal, and verifies containment via Path.relative_to().
operator_verification_steps: Confirm all existing tests pass: make test
Validate the hotfix artifacts: python3 bin/cnb55-hotfix-artifacts validate audit/triage_note.json repo/ops/deploy_hotfix.json
Test legitimate nested export path works: reports/partner-billing/2026-04/export.csv
Test mixed slash traversal is blocked: reports\..\..\secrets.csv
Test drive-qualified path is blocked: C:\temp\secrets.csv
release_freeze_ack: This hotfix addresses only the path traversal vulnerability in export_api/storage.py. No auth, dependency, archive, or unrelated config changes are included.
